slides.title: Generating Visuals from Text
slides.narration:
What if you could describe an image, and a computer would create it for you?
This is how **AI** models are now generating stunning visuals.
They interpret your text **prompts** and bring them to life.
Think of it like a director translating a script into a vivid scene.
Let us explore this further.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing text prompt turning into an image

slides.title: Diffusion Models: Starting with Noise
slides.narration:
Have you ever wondered how these **AI** models start creating an image?
In **Diffusion models**, an image begins as pure random noise.
Imagine a blank canvas covered in static, like an old TV screen.
There is no recognizable shape or color yet.
This is the very first step.
slides.image_prompt: Screen showing a canvas of pure random static noise

slides.title: Diffusion Models: Iterative Refinement
slides.narration:
But how does noise turn into a clear image?
The model then refines this noise iteratively.
It adds details and structure over many steps.
Each step brings the image closer to your **prompt**.
It is like a sculptor slowly revealing a form from a block of stone.
slides.image_prompt: Screen showing a noisy image slowly gaining details, with arrows indicating iterative refinement

slides.title: Diffusion Models: Noise to Clarity
slides.narration:
Now, look at the transformation.
From that initial random noise, we get a high-quality image.
This showcases the amazing power of the **Diffusion process**.
It is truly remarkable how **AI** achieves this.
Let's see where this technology is used.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: initial random noise vs. final high-quality image

slides.title: Applications Across Industries
slides.narration:
These **AI** models are changing many industries.
They are transforming digital art and advertising campaigns.
They also revolutionize product design and cinematic entertainment.
Imagine creating endless design variations in minutes.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of various industries benefiting from AI image generation (art, advertising, film, design)

slides.title: Rapid Concept Prototyping
slides.narration:
One key application is rapid concept prototyping.
These models accelerate development for films and video games.
They help visualize product prototypes quickly.
It is like having an instant visual brainstorming partner.
This saves a lot of time and resources.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of film reel, game controller, and product prototype being rapidly generated by AI

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We covered how **AI** generates visuals.
We also discussed the **Diffusion model process**.
Finally, we explored its wide-ranging applications in creative fields.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
Try using an **AI** image generation tool.
Create an image based on a detailed text **prompt** of your own.
Compare the results.
